name: Down the Road
source:
After two years in juvie, the MC steps back into a world that’s moved on without him. Haunted by fractured memories and the tragedy that tore his life apart, he’s done looking for answers.

As the MC digs deeper, he crosses paths with others carrying burdens of their own. In a city built on lies and blood, they’ll need each other to survive what’s coming, even if trust is the one thing they can’t afford.

[From [url=https://bananah1.itch.io/down-the-road-ch-1-far-from-any-road]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在少年监狱呆了两年后，主持人回到了一个没有他的世界。破碎的记忆和撕裂他生活的悲剧困扰着他，他不再寻找答案。

随着MC深入挖掘，他遇到了其他背负着自己负担的人。在一座建立在谎言和鲜血之上的城市中，他们需要彼此才能在即将到来的事情中生存，即使信任是他们无法承担的一件事。

[来自[url=https://bananah1.itch.io/down-the-road-ch-1-far-from-any-road]Itch.io[/url]]
